name: orca-skills
description: Skills that add a GitHub-Issues backlog and planning layer on top of the Orca app — migrate a repo's tracking onto the model, triage raw issues into plannable ones, plan work adversarially, hand it off to a worktree agent, watch the lanes, and gate the result against the issue's own acceptance checklist. Requires Orca.

plugins.name: orca
plugins.description: Requires the Orca app. A GitHub-Issues backlog and planning layer over Orca's worktree/terminal CLI: migrate, triage, plan, handoff, status, verify.
